description: This file contains test helper functions for the 'repositories_test' package, including functions to create fake data for analysis and commit rows, as well as functions to clear specific database tables before and after tests.

classes.name: ent.AnalyzedDiffRow
classes.description: Represents a row of analyzed differences between upstream and downstream projects.

classes.name: ent.DiffRow
classes.description: Contains detailed information about a specific difference, such as date, projects involved, and change metrics.

classes.name: ent.AnalyzedCommitRow
classes.description: Represents a row of analyzed commit information.

classes.name: ent.CommitRow
classes.description: Contains information about a specific git commit, including date, hash, project, author, and subject.

methods.name: fakeFixtures
methods.description: Generates a list of fake analyzed difference rows for testing purposes.

methods.name: fakeCommitFixtures
methods.description: Generates a list of fake analyzed commit rows for testing purposes.

methods.name: clearTableBeforeAfterTest
methods.description: Returns a function to clear a specified table, to be used for setup and teardown in tests.

methods.name: clearTable
methods.description: Executes a SQL command to truncate (clear) the specified database table.
